scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0128; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘That guy is Sam.’ and ‘That guy is Leo.’ are grammatical and natural for the bounded informal guy sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps guy to «مرد» and preserves the intended informal reference across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are short A1 alternatives with clearly different meanings or referents.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner responses are short identification sentences with one new lexical target and familiar grammar.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the identified person/location cue while preserving the same informal noun sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, turns, and final retrieval all assess the same lexical objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded informal noun sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
